name: garmidian
description: Garmin dashboard builder for Obsidian: paste a Personal API key, pick sports and metrics, insert a ready Dashy dashboard.

scripts.release:check: opdk release check && npm run scorecard:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.capture: npm run build && CAPTURE=1 playwright test capture && opdk demo
scripts.video:clips: npm run build && VIDEO=1 playwright test e2e/video.spec.ts -c playwright.video.config.ts
scripts.video:studio: npm run video:manifest && video/node_modules/.bin/remotion studio video/src/index.ts --public-dir=video/public --config=video/remotion.config.ts
scripts.video:render: npm run video:manifest && video/node_modules/.bin/remotion render video/src/index.ts GarmyOverview out/video/garmy-overview.mp4 --public-dir=video/public --config=video/remotion.config.ts --codec=h264 --crf=18
